title: ha-notice notification (input)
description: The JSON object read by send --stdin-json or --file. Unknown fields exit 20 invalid_payload. Sanitizing, the cut of a title to 256 characters after sanitizing, the empty-message check (message has no minLength here; an absent message is also empty_message), the command-keyword check, the exact link rule (also for each action uri), the 64 character limit of an action title and the 3 action limit are applied by the tool and are not expressible here.

title.description: Untrusted. At most 100000 characters of input (more is exit 20 invalid_payload); cut at 256 characters after sanitizing with an ellipsis and truncated: true; one line (newlines become spaces).

message.description: Untrusted. At most 100000 characters of input; must not be empty after sanitizing or absent (empty_message) and must not be a command message.

link.description: Coarse gate only: 1 to 1024 printable ASCII characters (U+0021 to U+007E). The tool is authoritative: scheme (case-insensitive http or https), host, port and the reasons link_invalid and link_scheme.

actions.description: Optional. At most 3 URI actions, shown in this order as notification buttons (the companion app's action URI). Each is refused, never cut or fixed, when invalid. A uri is checked by the tool with the link rule (http and https only) and config link_hosts; the schema is a coarse gate. Not a command: actions are never the message.

title.description: Untrusted. At most 100000 characters of input; sanitized like a title (one line); empty after sanitizing, or more than 64 characters after sanitizing, is exit 20 invalid_payload (never cut).

uri.description: Coarse gate only: the link rule (printable ASCII, 1 to 1024 characters, http or https, link_hosts). Exit 20 link_invalid or link_scheme with pointer /actions/<i>/uri.
